answer.rationale: Roll out simplified onboarding for self-serve SMB accounts. It has confirmed improvements in completion, time-to-value, early adoption, and 30-day retention, supporting sustainable qualified revenue without training customers to depend on discounts. Do not counter the competitor with promotional pricing: the prior targeted discount increased acquisition and qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, a material downstream-value risk. This does not directly prove reduced price-driven churn, so monitor churn and activation outcomes closely once verification capacity reopens.
